newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free-mkt wheat, barley with refunds.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free-mkt wheat, barley with refunds.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export around 312,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of some six Ecus per tonne through its main tender programme, grain traders said.
The EU's cereals management committee also awarded licences to export around 235,000 tonnes of free-market barley at a maximum refund of 30.98 Ecus per tonne, they said.
There was no immediate official confirmation of the trade reports.
The EU also awarded licences to export 80,700 tonnes of free-market rye at a maximum refund of 30.00 Ecus per tonne.

In a separate tender the EU awarded 21,375 tonnes of free-market soft wheat for export to African, Caribbean and Pacific nations at a maximum refund of 10.00 Ecus per tonne, they said. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
